testimonials.title: Super Quick, Always Contactable, And Took Care Of Everything We Wanted
testimonials.content: We have worked with **brightseed.** for the initial build and subsequent maintenance of our website. They were, and continue to be, fantastic. Super quick, always contactable, and took care of everything we wanted, even when our explanations of what we wanted were less than technically accurate. Would 100% recommend to any businesses looking for a website that stands out from the cookie-cutter designs you see everywhere.
